title: Beyond End-to-End Black-Box Mapping: An Intentional Agent Framework for Cognitively Driven Facial Reaction Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.34419v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In dyadic human-human interactions, a listener's facial reactions reflect latent states containing memories of earlier interactions, thoughts, emotions, and expectations. However, many facial reaction generation (FRG) methods predict reactions from speaker behaviour and interaction history without explicitly modelling these factors or connecting ongoing interpretation with latent state evolution and facial feedback. We introduce the Intentional Facial Reaction Generation Agent (IFRGA), which uses an explicit latent state to connect interaction interpretation with facial reaction generation. Its Latent State Evolution Module (LSEM) updates this state using relevant memory, retained thoughts, and current speaker behaviour through a computational mechanism inspired by human thought processes. translated_title: 超越端到端黑盒映射：面向认知驱动的面部反应生成的意向性智能体框架
translated_abstract: 在双人人际互动中，听者的面部反应反映了包含早期互动记忆、想法、情绪和期望的潜在状态。然而，许多面部反应生成（FRG）方法仅根据说话者行为和互动历史来预测反应，既没有显式地建模这些因素，也没有将持续的解读与潜在状态演化及面部反馈联系起来。我们提出了意向性面部反应生成智能体，它使用显式的潜在状态将互动解读与面部反应生成连接起来。其潜在状态演化模块通过一种受人类思维过程启发的计算机制，利用相关记忆、保留的想法和当前说话者行为来更新该状态。在LSEM内部，内在思维流在多次更新之间传递想法，使解读能够在先前想法的基础上逐步构建，同时融合（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出IFRGA框架，通过显式潜在状态、潜在状态演化模块（LSEM）和内在思维流（ITF）模拟人类记忆、思维与情绪的认知过程，超越了传统端到端黑盒映射的面部反应生成方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces IFRGA, an intentional agent framework that explicitly models latent cognitive states via a Latent State Evolution Module and Inner Thought Flow to achieve cognitively driven facial reaction generation, moving beyond end-to-end black-box mapping.
